en.headline: Perfect surf!
en.advice: The morning conditions are ideal for surfing in Coxos, with 1.1m waves and light wind. It's a good opportunity to catch some consistent waves. The best time to surf is at 08:00. Don't forget to wear a suitable wetsuit.
en.crowdTip: Arrive early to avoid the crowd
en.moonTideLine: Waning crescent · Neap tides · low tide 19:00
